label: Portrait Glass
description: Curated people-photography optics — every item is a lens a working portrait, boudoir or street shooter would actually mount. Tagged studio/boudoir/street/night so templates draw a coherent kit.

items.name: 85mm-f14
items.text: shot on an 85mm f/1.4 prime wide open, gentle telephoto compression keeping the features honest, focus a knife-edge on the near iris, the background collapsing into deep unbroken bokeh
items.text_short: 85mm f/1.4, eye-critical focus, deep creamy bokeh

items.name: 105mm-beauty
items.text: shot on a 105mm f/1.4 beauty telephoto, the face compressed flat and flattering, one plane of the features critically sharp, specular catchlights crisp in both eyes

items.name: 135mm-headshot
items.text: shot on a 135mm f/1.8 at head-and-shoulders distance, the background stacked close and melted to smooth fields of color, the face carved out by compression alone

items.name: 70-200-fashion
items.text: shot on a 70-200mm f/2.8 zoom racked to the long end, runway-style compression, the subject lifted clean off a backdrop reduced to a seamless gradient

items.name: 50mm-f12
items.text: shot on a 50mm f/1.2 normal prime, perspective matching the naked eye, a whisper-thin plane of focus and highlights going soft and luminous wide open

items.name: 35mm-reportage
items.text: shot on a 35mm reportage prime stopped to f/5.6 and zone-focused for speed, subject and street held together in one honest plane of context

items.name: 28mm-hip
items.text: shot on a 28mm compact prime from chest height, everything from arm's reach to the far curb acceptably sharp, the frame wide enough to swallow the whole scene
items.text_short: 28mm from the hip, deep street sharpness

items.name: noct-f10
items.text: shot on an f/1.0 noct prime wide open, focus wafer-thin on the subject, every practical light in the depth swelling into a soft glowing disc
items.text_short: f/1.0 noct prime, glowing bokeh discs

items.name: vintage-sonnar
items.text: shot on uncoated pre-war 85mm glass, gentle veiling flare lifting the blacks, the out-of-focus field swirling softly toward the frame edges
items.text_short: uncoated vintage 85mm, lifted blacks, swirly bokeh

items.name: black-mist
items.text: shot through a quarter-strength black-mist diffusion filter, highlights blooming gently, micro-contrast tamed so skin reads luminous while the eyes stay sharp
items.text_short: black-mist diffusion, blooming highlights, luminous skin

items.name: anamorphic-close
items.text: shot on close-focus anamorphic glass, oval bokeh stretching vertically behind the shoulders, a faint horizontal streak crossing the frame at every point light
items.text_short: anamorphic close-up, oval bokeh, horizontal flare
